name: Zetta ERP
author: Joy Ahmed

sections.description:
Zetta ERP is a scalable, user-friendly, and efficient ERP system that allows businesses to manage HR, CRM, and financial transactions—all within their WordPress dashboard.

🔹 No need for multiple tools – Zetta ERP centralizes business operations in one system.
🔹 Scalable & Customizable – Enable only the modules you need.
🔹 User-Friendly Interface – A modern UI with an intuitive workflow for better efficiency.

🎯 Key Features:

✅ HR Management – Employee records, attendance tracking, department structuring.
✅ Accounting – Create invoices, track transactions, and manage accounts receivable.
✅ CRM – Store customer details, manage multiple addresses.
✅ Role & Permission Management – Control access to different business modules.
✅ Security & Privacy – Built with best practices for data protection and compliance.

Installation & Setup Guide

Step 1: Pre-installation Requirements

Before installing Zetta ERP, ensure the following:
✔ Your WordPress installation is updated to the latest version.
✔ Your hosting meets the minimum PHP and MySQL requirements.
✔ You have deactivated and removed any conflicting ERP or business management plugins.

Step 2: Installing Zetta ERP

1️⃣ Log in to your WordPress Admin account.
2️⃣ Go to Plugins > Add New in the WordPress dashboard.
3️⃣ Search for “Zetta ERP” or click Upload Plugin if installing from a ZIP file.
4️⃣ Click Install Now and then Activate the plugin.

Step 3: Initial Configuration

1️⃣ Go to Zetta ERP > Settings to configure the core settings.
2️⃣ Set your business details under Organization Settings.
3️⃣ Configure your weekends in Weekends Settings.
5️⃣ Optionally, seed your ERP with sample data under Settings > Seed Dummy Data.

Step 4: Basic Functionality Test

After installation, perform these quick tests:
✔ CRM: Create a test customer and verify that it appears correctly.
✔ HRM: Ensure employee records and attendance tracking work as expected.
✔ Accounts: Add a sample transaction and confirm financial tracking functions properly.

🚀 Zetta ERP is now ready to streamline your business!

sections.faq:
❓ Who is Zetta ERP for?

Zetta ERP is designed for businesses, startups, and SMEs looking to streamline HR, CRM, and accounting within WordPress.

❓ Do I need extra software to run Zetta ERP?

No! Zetta ERP is a standalone solution that works entirely within WordPress.

❓ Can I customize Zetta ERP?

Absolutely! You can enable or disable modules as per your business needs.

❓ Is my data secure?

Yes! Zetta ERP follows industry-standard encryption and privacy protocols to ensure maximum security.

❓ Does Zetta ERP integrate with third-party plugins?

We are continuously adding new integrations! Stay updated by visiting Zettabyte Incorp.

❓ Is there a Pro version?

Yes! The Pro version (coming soon) will include advanced reports, user role management, multi-user access, and more.
